_comment: Story scene carrying a mirrored cutscene dialogue log — exercises components/story/LogPanel.vue via the scene === 'story' branch in app.vue. Covers every row variant the panel distinguishes: place captions (including a mid-episode change of location), a speaker with both title and portrait, a speaker with a portrait but no title, embedded newlines rendered via white-space: pre-line, a speaker whose portrait slug resolves to nothing (404 leaves an empty hex), a Monologue row whose name line is reserved but blank, a long passage exercising the reading measure, and both choice-outcome accents.

storyLog.content: The Library, Floor of General Works

storyLog.title: Ex-Grade 1 Fixer
storyLog.content: So this is the Library. Cosier than the rumours made it sound.

You are late.
The guests have already arrived.

storyLog.title: Floor of General Works
storyLog.content: Welcome back, Roland. Please try not to break anything this time.
The lights dim. Somewhere far below, a page turns on its own.

storyLog.title: Ex-Grade 1 Fixer
storyLog.content: You want the long version? Fine. The Fixers came through here first, and by the time anyone thought to count what was missing there was nobody left who remembered what had been here to begin with. That's the trouble with this district — it forgets faster than it burns, and it burns fairly often.
